name: Demon Slayer
description: Follow Tanjiro Kamado's journey to become a Demon Slayer and save his sister Nezuko from her demonic curse. An epic tale of determination and sisterly love.
author: Koyoharu Gotouge

name: Solo Leveling
description: An action-packed manhwa about a hunter who gains the ability to level up like a video game character. Watch as Sung Jinwoo becomes increasingly powerful.
author: Chugong

name: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: When Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed finger, he becomes the host for a powerful demon. Join him at Tokyo Jujutsu High as he learns to master his new power.
author: Gege Akutami

name: Dune
description: The epic saga of the desert planet Arrakis, its precious spice, and the political intrigue surrounding the most valuable substance in the universe.
author: Frank Herbert
